purpose: Electron desktop cockpit for driving Claude Code CLI sessions across projects — Terminal + 25+ config/observability/scheduling tabs, plus a mobile web companion.
what: The app is organized around a **TAB → EPIC → PRD** hierarchy: a Terminal tab is anchored to one project cwd (`session-manager-operations/`), Epics are tagged Claude sessions (`feature`/`bug`/`discussion`/`build`) with a strict 3-state lifecycle (`proposed`→`active`→`completed`), and the scheduler runs PRDs authored inside an Epic's session as `claude -p` jobs with a machine-wide concurrency cap.

Recent work (git log + Epics) has been heavily focused on **navigation/UI consolidation**: merging Home-face vs Project-face Scheduler screens back together (`119c20d`), splitting Scheduler into 'Configs' vs 'Execution Queue' by face (`481cef1`), giving the Home tab its own distinct left-nav vs Project tabs, and collapsing the Epic Queue toolbar into one Actions menu (`c246810`) — the currently active Epic 'Actions Dropwn in EPIC Queue' continues this thread.

A second active thread is **Project Home / Project Pages**: `projectPages.cjs` + the `project-home-builder` agent generate static marketing/feature/architecture HTML pages from a component library and computed project summary (Stage 2 deterministic variants, Stage 4 display — `2f02cf9`, `be9cf33`, `97a8fe9`), landed alongside a `Component Library mocks` commit today (`1e4295e`).

An active perf bug ('v51 has big Perf Issues' — tab-switching slowness, suspected memory leak) is open and unaddressed in the git log shown, worth checking `state/live.ts`/transcript ring-buffers first given the CLAUDE.md's per-tab derived-state architecture.

Scheduler reliability has had multiple recent fixes: `94445fd` changed dead-job reaping to read from `queue.json` instead of an in-memory `runningSet`, and `a98fccd` added an 'investigating' status — consistent with the completed Epic history of scheduler status desyncs ('stuck running after clean exit') and 'nothing marked as in progress' trust issues.

scope.text: No 'general' OWNERS namespace — architecture/design-mocks/HUMAN_LEARN/reviews are skill-authored artifacts outside the app's IPC write path, not runtime state needing single-writer protection
Scheduler reimplemented as a viewer/operator over TAB→EPIC→PRD, scoped to active TAB's project by default (v0.39.4)
Scheduler's Home/Project faces merged back into one combined screen after being split, then re-split into 'Scheduler Configs' vs 'Epic's Execution Queue'
Epic Queue toolbar consolidated into a single Actions menu (New Epic / Run Build), replacing separate buttons

conventions: Every Epic is born `proposed`; only Approve&start or first-prompt-submit transitions to `active` — never created directly active.
status:'proposed' replaced the retired feedback-folder intake; propose-epic is the only way to file async work.
Single-writer law (`opsOwnership.cjs`) is fail-closed per operations namespace; cross-writer needs are explicit path-scoped delegations.
Never return a freshly-built value from a zustand selector (causes React #185 blank-app crash) — three prior incidents.
Cap `claude -p` concurrency at 3 machine-wide; OOM incident on 2026-06-10 at 5 parallel.
Pin `--model` explicitly on any automated `claude -p`/`claude --print` call site.
